name: Ikemen Senshuuraku Bangai Hen ~Miyabi-senpai no Ren'ai Jijou~
original_name: イケメン千秋楽 番外編～雅先輩の恋愛事情～
source:
In a world where sumo is the most popular sport...
Azusa and Miyabi grow from childhood friends to lovers.
High school is a time of future choice.

Become a sumo? Become an idol? ... Fall in love?
